definitions.gloss: to fasten, to fix, to secure
definitions.explanation: To attach or secure something in place using pins, clips, screws, or similar fasteners.
To hold something in place, especially hair or fabric, with a pin or clip.

examples.japanese: ねじで{板|いた}を{留|と}める。
examples.english: To fasten the board with screws.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}をクリップで{留|と}めた。
examples.english: I fastened the documents with a clip.

examples.japanese: ボタンが{留|と}められない。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{留|と}める.

HOMOPHONES:
・{止|と}める - to stop
・{泊|と}める - to let stay overnight
・{留|と}める - to fasten (this entry)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ピンで{留|と}める (to pin)
・クリップで{留|と}める (to clip)
・ねじで{留|と}める (to screw in)
・{髪|かみ}を{留|と}める (to pin up hair)
・ボタンを{留|と}める (to fasten a button)
